description.value: Fiorino is an authentic Florentine-inspired Italian street food restaurant founded by Florence native Giovanni Mascagni, built around house-baked Tuscan schiacciata bread sandwiches crafted using centuries-old techniques learned at Florence's Mercato di Sant'Ambrogio. The Lonsdale Quay Market location seats up to 150 guests and offers a full Italian cocktail and wine bar alongside its sandwich and dinner menus. A second location operates in Vancouver's Chinatown.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Lonsdale Quay Market location of a two-location Italian street food business: phone 604.341.5691 and address #218 123 Carrie Cates Court match OSM exactly. The site lists Uber Eats and describes schiacciata sandwiches as street food, confirming takeout. No bike parking, washroom, or Wi-Fi amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Multi-location business: a second Fiorino location exists at 212 East Georgia Street, Vancouver (Chinatown). The OSM record and this listing refer specifically to the Lonsdale Quay Market location only.
Website front page prominently features 'Historic Chinatown Dining' messaging, which could cause confusion with the North Vancouver location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Italian restaurant inside Lonsdale Quay Market with confirmed contact details and active website. A useful food stop for cyclists riding the North Shore waterfront.
